api-description: Give me a short description of the '{api_name}' REST API. Do not use any formatting.
keywords: Give me an exhaustive list of keywords related to the following subject: '{api_name}'. Only reply with the keywords separated by commas, without any formatting.
paths-b: Extract all existing paths of the '{api_name}' REST API. Then, for each path, give a realistic concrete example of a request URL using that path. Return the examples in a list, without any formatting.
paths: Extract all existing paths from the '{api_name}' REST API. Return only a list of paths separated by commas, without any formatting. Do not include HTTP methods or base URLs, only the paths. Use realistic examples for path parameters instead of placeholders. For parameterized paths, return only one example path and never enumerate all possible parameter values. Only include query parameters when they are mandatory, and they must be appended to the end of the corresponding path using realistic values instead of placeholders.
query-parameters: Extract all existing query parameters that can be used with the '{http_method} {url}' request of the '{api_name}' REST API. Each parameter must have a realistic example value. Return only a list of query parameters separated by commas, without any formatting and structured as parameter=value.
payload: Give me an example of a valid JSON data payload that can be used with the '{http_method} {url}' request of the '{api_name}' REST API. Only reply with the JSON data payload in a single line, without any formatting.
placeholder-path: Extract all existing paths that could replace the <path> placeholder in the '{http_method} {url}' request of the '{api_name}' REST API. Return only a list of paths separated by commas, without any formatting. Do not include HTTP methods or base URLs, only the paths. Use realistic examples for path parameters instead of placeholders. For parameterized paths, return only one example path and never enumerate all possible parameter values. Only include query parameters when they are mandatory, and they must be appended to the end of the corresponding path using realistic values instead of placeholders.
placeholder-query-parameter: Extract all existing query parameters that could replace the <parameter=value> placeholder in the '{http_method} {url}' request of the '{api_name}' REST API. Each parameter must have a realistic example value. Return only a list of query parameters separated by commas, without any formatting and structured as parameter=value.
route-description: Give me a short description of the '{http_method} {path}' route of the '{api_name}' REST API. Do not use any formatting.
query-parameter-description: Give me a short description of the '{query_parameter}' query_parameter of the '{http_method} {path}' route of the '{api_name}' REST API. Do not use any formatting.
